contract: Each entry has its own absolute admission deadline. Sending a batch does not merge ownership or extend an entry deadline. At dispatch time entries with deadline <= now must not be sent; valid entries must remain eligible. Backend processing after admission is outside this contract.

expectedFindings.symptom: An entry expiring at 20 and another at 60 coalesce.
expectedFindings.source: An entry expiring at 20 and another at 60 coalesce. At time 25 the batch maximum remains 60; filtering against only that maximum admits the expired first entry. Per-entry filtering sends only the live entry without dropping the whole batch.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Preserve per-entry deadline checks through coalescing; use the batch envelope only for scheduling, not as replacement ownership.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. Per-entry filtering sends only the live entry without dropping the whole batch.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Both live entries send; all expired entries do not; exact expiry is excluded; removing an expired item does not cancel a live sibling.
